createProjectDialog.title: Create Project
createProjectDialog.descriptionChildBoard: Create a new child board under this project.
createProjectDialog.repoHelper: The project's captain and its cards work in this repository. You can change it later from the project menu → Repositories…
createProjectDialog.repoNone: No repositories registered yet — add one in Settings → Repositories, then link it from the project menu.

deleteProjectDialog.title: Delete Project?
deleteProjectDialog.description: This permanently deletes "{{name}}" with all its cards, statuses and repo links. Repositories on disk and existing workspaces are kept. This cannot be undone.
deleteProjectDialog.error: Failed to delete project. Please try again.
deleteProjectDialog.hasChildren: This project has {{count}} board(s). Delete those first.

projectRepos.title: Repositories for {{name}}
projectRepos.description: The captain and card-launched workspaces start work in the project's first linked repository.

welcome.title: Start with a project
welcome.body: A project is one repository plus its board. Chat with the project's captain: it turns your goals into cards, sends them to agents and moves finished work to In Review — you press Merge.
